title: Bread for Every Family

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: Not everyone in Bellhaven has enough to eat in winter. The baker gave us loaves to share with families who need them.

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: Would you please share them out fairly, the same for every family?

steps.speaker: greta
steps.prompt: Share the loaves so every family has the same.

older.prompt: Share twenty-three loaves fairly among five families. Any left over go to the soup kitchen.

feedback.all_good: {n} loaves for every family. Nobody will go hungry tonight.

outro.speaker: greta
outro.text: Thank you, my dear. When we share what we have, there's always enough to go round.

outro.speaker: greta
outro.text: What a week you've had in Bellhaven! Next week: Lantern Night.

journal_line: I shared bread fairly among families in Bellhaven who needed it.
